reader_tasks.task: Choose a platform for a particular memory question
reader_tasks.answer_from_text: Identify which changing state carries the value, where weights reside, which update/noise law is controllable and whether the required model time is met. The introduction states these criteria before the common comparison table.

reader_tasks.task: Explain what the recent studies establish
reader_tasks.answer_from_text: Loihi provides useful input history; SpiNNaker2 maintains measured recurrent state for the observed gap; PCM adaptation changes weights using host-assisted work; CrTe3 stabilizes programmed resistance. The separate evidence objects and limits are explicit.

m retains an alpha fraction and receives beta-scaled input. After input ends, repeated retention gives alpha^n. Matching that decay to an exponential ties memory time to physical update spacing. The numeric clock comparison answers why slow is relative.

reader_tasks.task: Set conditions for a later fair experiment
reader_tasks.answer_from_text: Specify task, readout error, delay and included hardware/host work. Communication continues taking wall time while accelerated state changes. Matrix-only energy is insufficient when other necessary work is outside its measured boundary.
